description: Pre-registered thread resolution cases (Ask threads v1, ADR-0056). Synthetic engineering content. Each case is an Ask with the asker's other threads, most recently asked first, and for most an open thread; thread numbers in expectations count from 1, as the resolver is shown them. A case's near_miss says which thread is related to the question's subject without being the same thing: it is for readers, and the resolver is never shown it.

previous.question: What's blocking the DVT gate?

statements.text: The DVT gate is blocked by THERM-482: the thermal fixture fails at 45 °C, so the 72-hour soak test cannot finish.

citations.label: THERM-482: Thermal fixture fails at 45 °C
